method: Direct inspection of the complete iteration-35 contact sheet. All seven iteration-35 page-render hashes are identical to the individually inspected iteration-34 renders. Checked title and abstract, equations, all three figures, table, captions, page breaks, corrected references, margins, glyphs, and links; no clipping, overlap, broken glyphs, unreadable labels, table overflow, or underfilled spill page remained.

observations.1-3: Title, abstract, literature framing, geometry, model diagram, equations, and detector-description text are clear and balanced.
observations.4-5: Diagnostic definitions, absolute-difference results, full table, and discussion are legible without overflow or misleading ratio graphics.
observations.6-7: Longitudinal figure, scope, conclusion, availability text, acknowledgments, AI statement, and complete 13-entry bibliography are clear; the final page is balanced.
